task: FE-70 / FV2-009 — Flutter Design V2 responsive stream selection rail
summary: Matched Flutter screen-selection rail and thumbnail cards to the production web Design V2 desktop and compact geometries while preserving stream selection and accessibility semantics.

checks.name: Test-first rail geometry regression
checks.observation: Before implementation, the test found the old 184×64 card instead of the web 152×96 desktop card. The final focused suite verifies desktop 900 px (100 px rail, 152×96 card, 142×60 thumbnail) and compact 390 px (84 px rail, 128×80 card, 118×48 thumbnail), cover scaling, selected live marker, selection, and semantic hints.
